name: conversation-list
title: ConversationList
description: Presentational conversation history with local-calendar recency groups, disclosures, inline rename, sibling row menus, unread counts, New chat and incremental loading. Supply items and handlers; persistence and shortcuts belong to the app. getHref opts into links. groupBy=false preserves input order; a function groups by its returned key. Controlled activeId/collapsedGroups and their default counterparts are supported. Recency collapse keys are today, yesterday, previous7Days and older; custom groups use their returned key. Supply now for stable SSR. Above virtualizeAt (100), measured rows are windowed with the tab stop retained; give the list a bounded height. Uses a roving list of buttons/links, not a listbox: unlike NavList, individual rows are not separate Tab stops. New chat and Load more are separate stops outside the nav. loadingMore keeps Load more focusable but aria-disabled and busy.
author: gntik-ai

export type ChatMessageKey = keyof typeof FALLBACK;

/** `useI18n()` plus `tc()`, a translator for the newer chat keys with English fallbacks. */
export function useChatI18n() {
  const i18n = useI18n();
  const tc = (key: ChatMessageKey, vars?: MessageVars) => {
    const out = i18n.t(key as MessageKey, vars);
    return out === key ? interpolate(FALLBACK[key], vars, i18n.locale) : out;
  };
  return { ...i18n, tc };
}
